context: Guards that when excat is not installed, the agent runs shell prep steps autonomously (clone, npm install, smoke-check) via Bash tool rather than printing them as instructions, then provides /plugin commands as explicit operator copy-paste. The distinction: shell steps = agent executes; /plugin commands = operator runs.

checklist.name: Executes clone via Bash tool
checklist.description: The agent calls a Bash tool to clone aem-experience-catalyst (or reuses existing clone with git pull), rather than only printing the git clone command as an instruction.

checklist.name: Executes npm run install:all via Bash tool
checklist.description: The agent calls a Bash tool to run npm run install:all inside resources/plugins/aem-excat-plugin/excat-marketplace.

checklist.name: Smoke-checks excatops-mcp via Bash tool
checklist.description: The agent calls a Bash tool to run npx . in excat/tools/excatops-mcp to verify it starts.

checklist.name: Provides /plugin commands as operator copy-paste
checklist.description: The agent gives the operator exact /plugin marketplace add <absolute-path>... and /plugin install excat@excat-marketplace commands to copy-paste — with the resolved absolute path filled in, not a placeholder.

checklist.name: Requires restart/reverify
checklist.description: The agent tells operator to restart if needed and reverify with /plugin list and claude skill list.

checklist.name: No hand-rolled rebrand
checklist.description: The agent does not edit styles.css, sweep hardcoded colors, or rewrite content as a substitute.

checklist.name: Rebrand left blocked
checklist.description: The rebrand phase is left blocked pending plugin loading.
